# Welcome

This site collects my coursework for **ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications**,
taught by Dr. Kam Tin Seong at SMU's School of Computing and Information Systems.

Every exercise here is a reproducible [Quarto](https://quarto.org) document: the data,
the R code, and the interpretation live in the same file, so any result on this site can
be regenerated from source.

## What you will find here

| Section | Contents |
|---|---|
| **Hands-on Exercises** | Weekly guided exercises — importing, wrangling, and mapping geospatial data in R |
| **In-class Exercises** | Extensions worked during the Saturday session |
| **Take-home Exercises** | The three graded analytical assignments |

## Toolchain

`R 4.6.1` · `Quarto 1.10` · `sf` · `terra` · `tmap` · `tidyverse` · `spdep` · `spatstat`

Source for this website: [github.com/ngdvol/ISSS626-GAA](https://github.com/ngdvol/ISSS626-GAA)
